title: Auditing Algorithmic Fairness in Machine Learning for Health with Severity-based LOGAN

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating accuracy disparities in in-hospital mortality prediction for patients with different health histories (e.g., diabetes, chronic illnesses) using severity-aware clustering of clinical notes.
Measuring model performance differences across insurance types (Medicaid, Medicare, Private) within localized patient clusters.
Assessing local group bias and accuracy disparities in clinical predictions across self-identified racial and ethnic categories.
Comparing in-hospital mortality prediction accuracy across assigned sex at birth (Assigned Male at Birth vs. Assigned Female at Birth).
Identifying predictive performance disparities based on whether the patient is recorded as an English speaker.
Measuring mortality prediction performance gaps associated with the presence of negative patient descriptors (stigmatizing language) in electronic health records.
